verdicts.why: S3E7 (#25) is the first time the team meets this Ultron: Kahhori suggests using an Ultron, the team confronts him, he spares them, says he wants to atone and powers their ship to the Fifth Dimension.

End of S2E5 (#14): Carter is pulled through a portal and wakes to Fury and Wanda, who say she is the one to save their queen and world. Wanda defending her to Thor and holding back the rift happen in S2E8 (#17), so the split is right.
S2E5 (#14) ends with Fury and Wanda having brought Carter to their world. Fury taking Thor's scepter on Wanda's signal is S2E8 (#17), which the split keeps.
Both are there when Carter wakes at the end of S2E5 (#14), saying she was brought to save their queen and world. In #17 Thor says she failed in what she was summoned to do.

value.title: X-Men '97#3
value.text: Scott learns that the wife who bore his son, Nathan, is Madelyne, Sinister's clone of Jean. Together they save Nathan, and then she leaves the team.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The clone wife who bore Scott's son, Nathan.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Madelyne's husband and the father of her son.

split.title: X-Men '97#5
split.text: After Madelyne leaves the team, Scott keeps talking to her in his mind.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The clone wife who bore Scott's son, Nathan.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Madelyne's husband and the father of her son.

verdicts.why: #5 is too late, but #1 would spoil the twist: in #1 and #2 she is shown as Jean, and the clone named Madelyne is only revealed in #3, where she and Scott save Nathan and she leaves. The proposed #3 split also wrongly held the telepathic contact, which is #5 (Remember It).

Moving this to #2 would spoil the #3 twist. The birth in #2 is shown as Jean's, and the mother is only revealed as the clone Madelyne in #3, where she saves Nathan and gives him to Bishop. The current #3 start is right.
Jean (really the clone) gives birth to Scott's son Nathan in #2. Scott is Nathan's father from then on, and the text on #2 does not reveal the clone.

Lifedeath Part 1 (the second segment of #4): Forge takes Storm to his ranch and they grow closer while he works on her powers. The Adversary poisons him in #4, and she regains her powers and heals him in Lifedeath Part 2 (#6).
In #4 the owl turns out to be the Adversary, which brings Storm back to the ranch and poisons Forge. Storm regains her powers and defeats it in #6.
The Adversary poisons Forge at the end of #4. Forge drives it out with his mother's spell book in #6.
The X-Men are shocked when Magneto reveals Xavier's will at the end of #1, and #2 opens with a distrustful Cyclops. The Blue Team assault on Asteroid M is in Tolerance Is Extinction Part 2 (#9).
In Bright Eyes (#7) the X-Men learn that Sinister and OZT are building an advanced Sentinel program. Bastion is shown as the power Sinister works with, and the two talk about Xavier and Magneto.
In #7 Cable arrives, defeats Trask and warns of the greater threat Sinister works with, Bastion. His warning that Bastion will use Genosha to start a 300-year war is in Part 1 (#8).
Tolerance Is Extinction Part 2 (#9): Beast and Forge build a collar that can block Bastion's technopathy and break his control over the Sentinels.
Beast and Forge build the collar in Part 2 (#9). Bastion captures Forge with Beast, Morph and Storm in Part 3 (#10).
Part 2 (#9): Storm and Jean's Gold Team goes to Bastion's Galapagos hideout. In Part 3 (#10) Bastion captures Storm and holds her by the neck.

value.title: X-Men '97#11
value.text: Archangel joins Cable and Psylocke in planning a new team to stop Apocalypse.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Leads Warren's new team against Apocalypse.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Joins Cable's new team to stop Apocalypse.

split.title: X-Men '97#12
split.text: Archangel executes War on Cable's orders.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Warren's X-Force leader, on whose orders Warren executes War.

verdicts.why: The start at #11 is right: it ends with Cable, Psylocke and Archangel planning a new team. But the proposal left Cable's card saying he executes War, which is #12, and the screen only names the team X-Force in #12, so the #11 lines avoid both.

The last scene of Part 3 (#10): in 3960 A.D., Scott and Jean meet Mother Askani with a young Nathan. Her telling him he is destined to kill Apocalypse and her pulling the X-Men through time come out in #11.
Danger.exe (#16) ends with Apocalypse raising Gambit in Athens as one of his Horsemen (alias Death, cited to that episode). In #18 Xavier finds Apocalypse's mind in control of Gambit.
Rise of Apocalypse Part 2 (#14): with Rogue among the X-Men there, Nur turns on them and takes Eson's power to become Apocalypse. Rogue pulls him out of Gambit and traps him in #19.
Candra is in Rama-Tut's court in Rise of Apocalypse Part 1 (#13; Marvel Database cites Season 2 3). Rama-Tut abandons her when he flees in #14.
At the train station Magneto pins Logan and throws him aside, while Sabretooth fights Storm and Cyclops. Logan and Sabretooth only fight again on the statue.
At the statue Magneto pins the X-Men to the walls, and Sabretooth arrives and removes Scott's visor.
Logan and Kayla free the captives, and Kayla leads them out. Gambit saves Logan from falling debris and, at Logan's request, makes sure the escaped mutants are safe.
Gambit does not free the captives himself. He returns to the island, saves Logan, and makes sure the mutants Logan and Kayla free get to safety.
At Bobby's family home in X2 the kiss lasts longer than they expected until her power starts to hurt him and he has to pull away. It does not nearly kill him.
Part 1 (#13) ends with Rama-Tut destroying the base the X-Men are in. Part 2 (#14) opens with Magneto shielding them from the blast.

split.text: When Jean becomes the Dark Phoenix, Scott fights the Shi'ar Imperial Guard in a trial of combat to save her.

split.on_b_card_about_a: Jean's husband. Fights the Shi'ar to save her.

verdicts.why: They marry in Till Death Do Us Part Part I (#14), so the earlier start is right. But the honeymoon kidnapping is Part II (#15), so it gets its own stage there. The Shi'ar trial of combat stays at #43.

verdicts.why: The clone reveal is #3, but the proposal kept the full text there, which would show #5 to #12 facts at #3. The strain over Jean's mixed memories is #5 (Remember It). They meet Askani and Nathan at the end of #10, decide to stay in #11 and are sent home in #12.

Phoenix Saga Part IV (#32): Corsair's Starjammers take Cyclops captive and Corsair plans to have him kill D'Ken. Only Phoenix learns, by reading his mind, that Corsair is Scott's father. Scott finds out in Orphan's End (#44).

The Unstoppable Juggernaut (#8) is Cain's first episode: he wrecks the mansion seeking revenge on his stepbrother Xavier. In The Juggernaut Returns (#46) he loses his power when someone else claims the gem, and Xavier gives it back to him.

Lifedeath Part 2 (#6): Lilandra announces her engagement to the healed Xavier, he refuses to purge his memories of Earth, and after a vision of Gambit's death he decides to return to Earth. Nothing in the stage first happens in #8.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#9

split.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#30
split.text: Moira cares for Xavier on Muir Island while he recovers.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's old love and closest friend.

verdicts.why: In #7 Moira is only mentioned, when Xavier phones his old friend at Muir Island. The Marvel Database lists her as mentioned there, and her first appearance is The Cure (#9), where Xavier visits her on Muir Island. Her care of him on Muir Island is Phoenix Saga Part II (#30), as the split says.
Proteus Part I (#56): Kevin escapes Muir Island to find his father and Moira calls the X-Men. Part II (#57): Xavier calms him and he goes back to Muir Island with Moira.
Phoenix Saga Part III (#31): Lilandra explains that her brother D'Ken wants to weaponize the M'Kraan Crystal and that she came to Xavier. D'Ken falls in Part V (#33).

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#12
value.text: Mystique, whose disguise Rogue exposed on Muir Island, reveals she is Rogue's foster mother. Rogue begs her to leave Apocalypse, but she refuses.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Rogue's foster mother, who serves Apocalypse.

split.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#22
split.text: Mystique took in the runaway Rogue and raised her, then sent her to attack Ms. Marvel. Now Rogue rejects her and tells her she is no longer her daughter.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The woman who raised and used Rogue.

verdicts.why: Days of Future Past Part II (#12) is where Mystique reveals she is Rogue's foster mother and refuses to leave Apocalypse. The proposal dropped Rogue exposing Mystique's disguise on Muir Island (Come the Apocalypse, #10), so that fact goes back into the #12 text as something that has already happened. The backstory and 'not your daughter anymore' are #22.
Tolerance Is Extinction Part 3 (#10) ends with Rogue and Nightcrawler among the X-Men stranded in 3000 B.C. Egypt. They are sent home in #14, and Kurt gives his life to Eson in #19.

split.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#59
split.text: After Graydon's plot against his mutant family fails, the Friends of Humanity drop him at his father's cabin.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Graydon's father, whom he fears and despises.

verdicts.why: Beauty & the Beast (#23) is where Wolverine recognizes Graydon as Sabretooth's son and exposes it, so the start is right. But the cards kept at #23 say Graydon hates and fears his father, which the Marvel Database cites to Bloodlines (#59). Those lines move to the #59 split.
